tools.name: cicero_event_get
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: Read metadata for the event associated with this API key.

theme.description: The theme of this edition, long form

startsOn.description: ISO date, in the event timezone

endsOn.description: ISO date, in the event timezone

speakerDeadlineAt.description: ISO 8601 instant the speaker roster is meant to be settled. Advisory, so no write is refused after it passes. Null when the organizers do not track it

agendaDeadlineAt.description: ISO 8601 instant the agenda is meant to be settled. Advisory, so no write is refused after it passes. Null when the organizers do not track it

tools.name: cicero_sessions_list
tools.title: List sessions
tools.description: Search and filter sessions for the event associated with this API key.

q.description: Search title, description, taxonomy, and speaker names

startsAfter.description: Keep sessions starting at or after this ISO 8601 instant

startsBefore.description: Keep sessions starting before this ISO 8601 instant

items.description: A scheduled session on the agenda

tools.name: cicero_speakers_list
tools.title: List speakers
tools.description: Search speakers on accepted submissions for this event.

q.description: Search name, biography, company, role, links, and sessions

headshotUrl.description: Absolute URL of the public headshot. Null when the speaker has not uploaded one or has not confirmed their profile yet, since nothing is served publicly until they do.

items.description: A speaker with at least one accepted session

tools.name: cicero_agenda_get
tools.title: Get agenda

theme.description: The theme of this edition, long form

startsOn.description: ISO date, in the event timezone

endsOn.description: ISO date, in the event timezone

speakerDeadlineAt.description: ISO 8601 instant the speaker roster is meant to be settled. Advisory, so no write is refused after it passes. Null when the organizers do not track it

agendaDeadlineAt.description: ISO 8601 instant the agenda is meant to be settled. Advisory, so no write is refused after it passes. Null when the organizers do not track it

date.description: ISO date in the event timezone

items.description: A scheduled session on the agenda
A scheduled session on the agenda

outputSchema.description: The published agenda, grouped by day

tools.name: cicero_submissions_list
tools.title: List submissions
tools.description: List event submissions, including private review status and submitter details.

answers.description: Custom form answers, keyed by field key

items.description: A CFP submission. Requires an API key.

tools.name: cicero_mail_templates_list
tools.title: List agent mail templates
tools.description: Inspect effective email templates for this event, including exact source copy and whether the agent send flow may use each one.

tools.name: cicero_mail_deliveries_list
tools.title: List recent email deliveries
tools.description: Read recent event-scoped delivery metadata. Bodies and attachments stay redacted because they can contain one-click credentials.

tools.name: cicero_mail_preview
tools.title: Preview one participant email
tools.description: Resolve one existing event participant against an enabled email template without sending or minting a live portal credential. Returns exact copy plus the confirmation required by send.

participantId.description: Participant id from this event; arbitrary email addresses are never accepted

recipientEmail.description: Exact event-participant address returned by preview; arbitrary addresses are rejected

confirmation.description: Copy the exact target-specific confirmation literal returned by preview

confirmationDigest.description: Copy the content-bound digest returned by preview

tools.name: cicero_mail_send
tools.title: Send one confirmed participant email
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: send the exact previewed event template to one existing participant. Requires a write key, exact target-specific confirmation, and the content-bound preview digest. Email preference is rechecked; SMS is never sent.

recipientEmail.description: Exact event-participant address returned by preview; arbitrary addresses are rejected

confirmation.description: Copy the exact target-specific confirmation literal returned by preview

confirmationDigest.description: Copy the content-bound digest returned by preview

tools.name: cicero_program_reconcile
tools.title: Reconcile program
tools.description: Preview or apply an Accelevents-shaped program reconciliation. Preview with apply=false before writing.

mode.description: merge upserts listed records; replace also deletes managed records that are absent

apply.description: False previews the exact operations without writing

confirmDeleteMissing.description: Required to apply replace mode when missing managed sessions would be deleted

externalId.description: Stable Accelevents session id; unique within this event

description.description: Required Markdown field; null or blank clears the description

room.description: Event room id or exact name (case-insensitive)

track.description: Event track id or exact name (case-insensitive)

format.description: Event format id or exact name (case-insensitive)

deleteExternalIds.description: Explicit source-managed sessions to delete in merge mode

inputSchema.description: An Accelevents-shaped program snapshot or patch
